purpose: Structured, quotable 2up/early-payout terms for the Lay Bet Finder badge. Only bookmakers verified on their own site on the date above appear here.
verification_method: Live browser check of each bookmaker's own promotions page and the full terms page linked from it (the 'FULL TERMS' / 'More info' link), 2026-10-27 13:30-13:50 UTC. Every quoted string is copied from the bookmaker's page. Our browser egress resolves to a non-UK IP, so 888sport served US-facing template content around the offer (dollar amounts on unrelated promotions); the 2 Up terms reference UK time and 90-minute football settlement and are the page the site's own 'FULL TERMS' link serves. Unibet's pages were served in UK form (GambleAware.org, GBP, Platinum Gaming Limited).

rules: Badge only feed keys present in 'bookmakers' with confirmed = true.
Anything not listed is unbadged - do not infer from other bookmakers.
badge_label is the card label; badge_tooltip is the hover text; both are final copy.
Badges never alter stake, lay stake, liability or profit figures.

excluded.bet365: Excluded. Not in our odds feed and no claim verified from its own site - we do not assert whether it runs a 2up offer.

badge_rules.market_match_warning: Both verified offers apply to a dedicated 2 Up market that is SEPARATE from the standard 90-minute match result price the Lay Bet Finder lists. A badge must never be read as 'the price I am looking at qualifies'. See market.is_dedicated_2up_market.
badge_rules.wording_rule: Badge text and tooltips describe the bookmaker's settlement rule only. No profit, value, edge or money-back claim; no guarantee the offer is available on a given match, competition or account.

market.summary: Bookmaker's dedicated 'FULL TIME RESULT - 2 Up' market, selected competitions only. Not the standard Full Time Result market.
market.verbatim: The promotion is available on selections placed on the “FULL TIME RESULT - 2 Up” market in selected competitions only (the Promotion Markets).

bet_types.verbatim: ‘2 Up’ is available on single and multiple bets.

sport.verbatim: 2 Up applies to 90 minutes (plus any additional time added on by the referee, excluding Extra Time and Penalties) only.

min_odds.reason: No minimum odds figure appears on the 2 Up offer page or in its full terms. Not stated - not verified absent for UK customers.

max_stake.reason: No maximum stake figure appears on the 2 Up offer page or in its full terms.

trigger_condition.summary: The backed team takes a two-goal lead at any point inside 90 minutes (plus referee's added time); the bet is settled as a winner whatever the final score.
trigger_condition.verbatim: If that team take a two-goal lead in the match at any time before 90 minutes (plus any additional time added on by the referee, excluding Extra Time and Penalties), we’ll settle the selection as a winner regardless of the result.

payout_type.summary: Early settlement as a winning bet (stake plus winnings paid as a normal win). Not a free bet - no token, no wagering, no expiry.
payout_type.verbatim: We will aim to settle all qualifying 2 Up bets within 15 minutes of your selection going 2 goals ahead.

expiry.reason: Not applicable: the payout is a settled win, so there is no free bet to expire. Null rather than a free-bet expiry date.

exclusions_verbatim: 2 Up is not available on Odds Boost markets.
Bets that are Cashed Out in full will no longer qualify for 2 Up. Bets that are partially cashed out, the remaining stake will still be eligible for 2 Up.
If your bet is paid out early in accordance with this promotion, it will not be paid out again if your selection goes on to win the match.
Bets placed using free bets will be eligible for 2 Up.
additional_terms_verbatim: 2 UP | YOUR BET'S A WINNER IF YOUR TEAM GOES 2 GOALS AHEAD
Bet on our 2 Up market and we'll settle your selection as a winner if your team leads by 2 goals at any point, regardless of the final result.
The promotion will run from 00:00:01 (UK time) on Tuesday 31st March 2026, until cancelled or withdrawn by us (the Promotion Period).
sport888.operator_note: Terms page served to us names Virtual Digital Services Limited (Malta) / Virtual Global Digital Services Limited (Gibraltar) as promoter; 888's site footer states GB customers are served by 888 UK Limited (UK Gambling Commission licence 39028). UK-facing licensing detail not re-verified from a UK IP.
sport888.badge_tooltip: 888sport pays out early if your team leads by 2 goals - its own 2-Up market only
sport888.badge_note: Early payout, not a free bet. Qualifies only on 888sport's 'FULL TIME RESULT - 2 Up' market in selected competitions - not on the standard Full Time Result price.

market.summary: Separate '2 Up / Early Payout' market on eligible football matches, typically shown below the standard match result market. Selections listed as Home / Draw / Away.
market.verbatim: The 2 Up / Early Payout market is a separate market from the standard Match Result (90 minutes) market.

bet_types.verbatim: Bets may be eligible for inclusion in multiples or bet builders where supported.

sport.verbatim: Available on selected football competitions only. Pre-match bets only (bets must be placed before kick-off).

min_odds.reason: No minimum odds figure appears on the 2-Up promotion page or its full terms.

max_stake.reason: No maximum stake figure appears on the 2-Up promotion page or its full terms.

trigger_condition.summary: The selected team goes two goals ahead at any time during the match (2-0, 3-1, 4-2, etc.); the bet is settled immediately as a winner regardless of the final result.
trigger_condition.verbatim: If the team selected in the 2 Up market goes two goals ahead at any time during the match, the bet will be settled immediately as a winner, regardless of the final result of the match.

payout_type.summary: Early settlement as a winning bet. Not a free bet - no token, no wagering, no expiry.
payout_type.verbatim: Settlement occurs immediately once the two-goal lead is achieved, and the bet result will not be affected by any later goals or the final match result.

expiry.reason: Not applicable: the payout is a settled win, so there is no free bet to expire. Null rather than a free-bet expiry date.

exclusions_verbatim: Cash Out is not available on bets placed in the 2 Up market.
Only bets placed on markets marked with the 2UP logo qualify for 2UP Early Payout.
If a goal is disallowed, overturned by VAR or recorded incorrectly by the data provider, settlement may be reversed, corrected, or delayed until the official match data confirms the correct score.
The sportsbook reserves the right to withdraw the 2 Up market from any event at any time.
Availability may vary by competition, region, or customer account.
additional_terms_verbatim: With 2-Up, your bet is settled as a winner the moment your team goes two goals ahead — no matter what happens next.
If your team goes two goals clear, your bet wins — no matter the final score. Enjoy the action with the chance to secure your win before full-time.
18+ | GambleAware.org. Selected pre-match football markets only. Bet settled as a winner when your team goes two goals ahead. Geo restrictions and T&Cs apply.
This means that more than one selection can be settled as a winner in the same match if multiple teams achieve a two-goal lead during play.
unibet_uk.operator_note: Promotional terms refer to Platinum Gaming Limited, whose trading names include Unibet, 32Red and Bingo.com.
unibet_uk.badge_tooltip: Unibet pays out early when your team goes 2 goals ahead - selected pre-match markets
unibet_uk.badge_note: Early payout, not a free bet. Qualifies only on Unibet's separate 2-Up market on selected pre-match football. Their own explainer also lists Draw among 2-Up selections - quoted only, do not build draw logic on the badge.
